rules.words: No plies at 90°: each of 0°, +45°, −45° and 90° should have at least 10 %.
rules.source: MIL-HDBK-17-3F, Volume 3: a laminate carried by its fibers in every direction

rules.words: No two plies of one angle next to each other; the limit is 4.
rules.source: Common practice: plies of one angle together crack apart more easily; thicker plies call for fewer

rules.words: Balanced: every angled ply has a partner at the opposite angle.
rules.source: Laminate theory: a balanced laminate does not shear when stretched (A16 = A26 = 0)
Laminate theory: a symmetric laminate does not bend when stretched (B = 0)
